summary: An R-6 flat-top cab built in 1957 on Waldo Mountain replaced two earlier lookouts and is reached only by a steep, fire-damaged trail.

facts.status_note: Unstaffed per the Forest Service and Wikipedia; NHLR describes emergency staffing during lightning storms.

staffing.status: unstaffed, no longer a functioning lookout

access.note: Reached by Waldo Mountain Trail #3592 from Salmon Creek; long, steep, and partly burned by the Cedar Creek Fire. No drive-up access.

visit.trail_note: Waldo Mountain Trail #3592 from Salmon Creek; alternate route from North Waldo Campground is confusing and not recommended for casual hikers.

events.note: Current R-6 flat-top cab built, replacing the cupola lookout; Wikipedia gives 1956 for this structure.
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register, November 24, 1995.

evidence.supports: First lookout built 1926/1929 sequence and current 1957 structure
evidence.quote: Waldo Mountain Lookout is a 15'x15' R-6 flattop ground house constructed in 1957. It replaced a D-6 cupola lookout built in 1929 which itself was a replacement for a pole and shake structure erected three years earlier.

evidence.supports: 1926 cabin, 1929 cupola, 1956 current lookout, currently unstaffed
evidence.quote: The original fire lookout tower was built on this site in 1926 and was a small cabin. In 1929 a cupola style lookout replaced the cabin. The current flat top lookout was built in 1956.
The lookout is currently unstaffed and no longer a functioning lookout.

evidence.supports: 1926 cabin, 1929 cupola, 1957 current R-6 flat cab, intermittently staffed, NHLR listed
evidence.quote: the first structure was a cabin built in 1926, replaced by a D-6 cupola cabin in 1929. The present R-6 flat cab, built in 1957, has been staffed intermittently.

evidence.supports: Lightning-storm value, period furnishings, trail access, unstaffed status, built 1957
evidence.quote: In its time, the lookout was an especially valuable observation post during the frequent lightning storms along the Crest. Though built in the 1950s, it was outfitted and furnished with original furniture and cabinetry, making it very authentic as well as comfortable.
To reach the Waldo Mountain Lookout, use the Waldo Mountain Trail #3592 from Salmon Creek. It is a long, fairly steep hike through forested areas and burned areas with a plethora of outlooks.
Built: 1957, Flat Roof ... Staffing: currently unstaffed and no longer a functioning lookout

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Wikipedia states 1956 for the current flat-top lookout; NHLR, the Forest Service, and the Forest Fire Lookout Association all state 1957. The story follows the 1957 majority but notes the discrepancy.

sources.title: Waldo Mountain Lookout
sources.publisher: Willamette National Forest, U.S. Forest Service

notes_for_editor: Build year of the current structure is disputed (1956 vs 1957) and staffing status is ambiguous (NHLR implies occasional emergency use; FS and Wikipedia say unstaffed/non-functioning). No rental program found for this lookout.
